policy: Huawei jobs are collected only from the anonymous official Huawei Careers campus portal and the public XHR/fetch traffic emitted by that page. No login, resume upload, CAPTCHA handling, private cookies or access-control bypass is used. The general domestic-graduate list is paired with Huawei's own quickSearch=AI entry so AI/Infra/compute roles cannot be hidden behind the first pages of a very large campus catalogue.

sources.evidence: Huawei official campus page renders public jobData.result rows from HW.Portal.Reccamp.Job.findJobList; current default domestic graduate route uses jobTypes=2 and job detail links use jobId plus dataSource.

sources.category: AI Infra/AI系统软件/算子/大模型/芯片软件
sources.evidence: Huawei Careers homepage itself links to campus-recruitment.html?quickSearch=AI; the campus page initializes seachParam.searchText from quickSearch before calling the same public findJobList flow.
